title: Kotlin Exception Model
learning_outcomes: Explain the central rule or purpose of kotlin exception model using at least one correct term from the lesson.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Kotlin Exception Model** as part of **Exceptions, Files, and Input/Output**. Catch or represent expected failures at a boundary where the program can respond usefully; do not silently swallow errors or expose secrets in messages. Use the subtopics—Exceptions and Error Conditions, Kotlin's Unchecked Exception Model, Java Checked-Exception Interoperability—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Real projects depend on reliable error handling, modular organization, reproducible builds, and safe language boundaries. This lesson helps turn isolated syntax into maintainable applications.

content_blocks.title: Common mistake to avoid
content_blocks.text: Catching every exception and ignoring it is a safe recovery strategy.
